findings.passage: In my opinion, this is an unneeded policy that will further disenfranchise voters. I believe the Legislature should focus on making voting more accessible, instead of creating additional barriers to this fundamental right.
findings.note: From her official legislative column. She is describing a bill heard in the Local Government and Elections Committee that would widen the grounds for removing voters from the registration rolls. Related to voter-roll rules, not ID.
